purpose: Define explicit scope and lifetime semantics for memory records so user-, identity-, Project-, module-, instance- and system-scoped memories cannot leak across boundaries by retrieval heuristics.

topics.name: Memory Scope and Lifetime
topics.purpose: Define explicit scope and lifetime semantics for memory records so user-, identity-, Project-, module-, instance- and system-scoped memories cannot leak across boundaries by retrieval heuristics.

semantics.scope_rule: Every record has an explicit scope owner/boundary.
semantics.visibility_rule: Retrieval candidates are filtered by applicable scope and authorization before relevance ranking.
semantics.lifetime_rule: Retention may be persistent, bounded-duration, event-bounded or explicit-until-removed.
semantics.expiry_rule: Expired memory is unavailable to normal retrieval and remains historical only where explicit retention/audit policy says so.
semantics.inheritance_rule: No scope inheritance is assumed unless explicitly declared.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant memory is explicit addressable provenance-bearing data; retrieval and storage never create hidden authority or implicit execution.

hard_gates.condition: memory retrieved across scope without explicit policy
relevance ranking occurs before scope/authorization filtering
expired memory used as active memory
